title: Security and Privacy Prompts in the Wild: What Users Ask LLMs and How LLMs Respond
abstract: arXiv:2606.18062v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer users' information needs: users ask LLMs about the weather, pose educational questions, and consult them for legal assistance. One particularly understudied area is digital security and privacy (S&P), where users may seek LLMs' help on how to secure their online accounts or protect their computers from cyber attacks. To the best of our knowledge, no prior study has collected or analyzed the S&P questions users ask LLMs; prior research on LLM response quality relied on expert-authored S&P misconceptions or FAQs rather than user queries. Drawing from WildChat, a dataset of 3.2M user-LLM conversations collected in the wild, our study identifies 14,727 S&P prompts and categorizes them into nine categories covering a wide range of S&P topics. translated_title: 真实场景中的安全与隐私提示：用户向大语言模型提出什么问题以及大语言模型如何回应
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于满足用户的信息需求：用户向大语言模型询问天气、提出教育问题，并咨询法律援助。一个尤其缺乏研究的领域是数字安全与隐私（S&P），用户可能会寻求大语言模型的帮助，例如如何保护在线账户安全或保护计算机免受网络攻击。据我们所知，此前尚无研究收集或分析过用户向大语言模型提出的安全与隐私问题；此前关于大语言模型回复质量的研究依赖的是专家撰写的安全与隐私误区或常见问题解答（FAQ），而非用户的真实查询。本研究基于WildChat——一个在真实环境中收集的包含320万条用户与大语言模型对话的数据集——识别出14,727条安全与隐私提示，并将其归纳为涵盖广泛安全与隐私主题的九个类别。我们抽样了450条安全与隐私提示，并进行了主题分析，以刻画用户向大语言模型提出的安全与隐私问题的特征。
tldr: 该研究首次基于WildChat真实数据集收集并分析了用户向大语言模型提出的安全与隐私问题，识别出14,727条此类提示并将其归纳为九大类别，通过主题分析刻画了用户的提问特征。
en_tdlr: This is the first study to collect and analyze real-world security and privacy questions users ask LLMs, identifying 14,727 S&P prompts from the WildChat dataset and categorizing them into nine categories through thematic analysis.
